hook.say: True or false? Five facts from the ends of the Earth, three seconds each. The last one looks like a horror movie!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.fact: Polar bears live only in the Arctic, around the North Pole.
questions.sayAnswer: False! Polar bears live only in the Arctic, on the other side of the planet.

questions.q: The South Pole is colder than the North Pole.
questions.fact: The South Pole sits high on land. The North Pole floats at sea level.
questions.sayAnswer: True! The South Pole sits high up on land. The North Pole is at sea level.

questions.fact: Mount Erebus is the southernmost active volcano on Earth.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Mount Erebus is the southernmost active volcano on Earth.

questions.q: The North Pole sits on solid land.
questions.fact: There is only drifting sea ice over the Arctic Ocean. No land at all.
questions.sayAnswer: False! There is no land there, only sea ice drifting over the Arctic Ocean.

questions.q: A blood-red waterfall flows from a glacier in Antarctica.
questions.fact: Blood Falls: salty, iron-rich water that turns red in the air.
questions.sayAnswer: True! It is called Blood Falls. Salty, iron-rich water turns rusty red in the air.
